## Total outbreaks managed

<div style="height: 0.5em;"></div>

:::{.indicator_box}
**Measure 3.1.4**

**Number of outbreaks allocated to the LPHU**

Numerator: Number of outbreak events managed by NEPHU during the reporting period
:::

<div style="height: 0.5em;"></div>

Data were extracted from PHESS via PHAR on `r format(Sys.Date(), format = "%d/%m/%Y")` for all outbreak events managed by NEPHU between `r format(quarter_start, format = "%d/%m/%Y")` and `r format(quarter_end, format = "%d/%m/%Y")`. 

* Confirmed and Probable outbreaks were excluded.

* Outbreaks due to any pathogen were included.

* Conditions not managed by LPHUs (anaphylaxis, elevated blood lead, human biosecurity reports, and tuberculosis) were excluded.

* Transmission Risk Area (TRA) events were excluded.

```{r}
#
outbreaks_nephu <- phar_outbreaks %>%
  dplyr::filter(event_classification %in% c("Confirmed", "Probable")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(event_date >= quarter_start | investigation_completed_date >= quarter_start) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!condition %in% conditions_tra) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = dplyr::case_when(
      condition == "Food-borne or water-borne illness" ~ as.character(organism_cause),
      condition == "Influenza" ~ as.character(organism_cause),
      TRUE ~ as.character(condition)),
    #
    condition = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(condition, "Influenza") ~ "Influenza",
      TRUE ~ as.character(condition))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::group_by(condition_type, condition) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals()

outbreaks_total <- outbreaks_nephu %>% 
  dplyr::filter(condition_type == "Total") %>% 
  pull(n)
```

<div style="height: 0.5em;"></div>

:::{.results_box}
`r format(outbreaks_total, big.mark = ",")` outbreaks were managed by NEPHU between `r format(quarter_start, format = "%d/%m/%Y")` and `r format(quarter_end, format = "%d/%m/%Y")`.
:::

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

**Total number of outbreaks managed by NEPHU between `r format(quarter_start, format = "%d/%m/%Y")` and `r format(quarter_end, format = "%d/%m/%Y")`**

```{r}
#
outbreaks_nephu %>% 
  knitr::kable(table.attr  = "style = \"color: black;\"",
               format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
               align       = "llr",
               col.names   = c("Reporting group",
                               "Condition",
                               "Outbreaks (n)")) %>% 
  #
  kableExtra::kable_styling() %>%
  #
  kableExtra::row_spec(row  = 0,
                       bold = TRUE) %>% 
  #
  kableExtra::row_spec(nrow(outbreaks_nephu),
                       bold      = TRUE,
                       extra_css = "border-top: 2px solid lightgray; border-bottom: 2px solid lightgray;")
```
